title: From Hallucination to Scheming: A Unified Taxonomy and Benchmark Analysis for LLM Deception
reasoning: The paper provides a taxonomy and survey of LLM deception benchmarks, which are fundamentally ethical in nature. It specifically addresses moral reasoning in the context of sycophancy, evaluates honesty versus accuracy, and includes benchmarks for unethical persuasion (PersuSafety) and alignment faking.
